notes: EBIT is implemented as Exelon operating income from the captured annual income statement table (not a formal EBIT line-item from a specific filing). ([investors.exeloncorp.com](https://investors.exeloncorp.com/financials-performance/income-statement/))

NWC is defined as Total current assets minus Total current liabilities from StockAnalysis (includes all current components as presented; does not exclude cash-like items unless reflected in total current asset classification). ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/financials/balance-sheet/))

Capex is taken as the absolute value of “Purchase of Fixed Assets” from the captured annual cash flow table. ([investors.exeloncorp.com](https://investors.exeloncorp.com/financials-performance/cash-flow/))

Base-case forecast drivers are assumption-based: revenue growth is anchored to the market-data summary revenue growth outlook and then smoothed with a gentle downtrend; margins and reinvestment ratios are anchored to historical levels and gradually normalized.

WACC (0.0527) and effective tax rate (0.1589) are sourced from StockAnalysis statistics; treat as market-data inputs rather than a fully rebuilt WACC from capital-structure and CAPM components. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/statistics/))
NOL balance is left null because the captured dataset did not provide an extractable NOL carryforward balance for 2025. NOL utilization is set to 0.80 per pipeline default.

Comps EV/NTM Revenue and EV/NTM EBITDA are set to null because the captured peer dataset provides forward P/E but not EV/NTM revenue/EBITDA explicitly. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/nee/))
Current price is set to $46.44 using market-data captured around Mar 20, 2026 close while the required as-of date is 2026-03-21. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/))

catalysts: Execution of the four-year capital plan and resulting rate base growth (7.9% cited for the outlook). ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))

Progress/outcomes of major rate cases and multi-year plan reconciliations across the utility footprint. ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))

Financing actions that influence interest expense and near-term earnings cadence. ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))
company_overview: Exelon is a utility services holding company focused on energy distribution and transmission businesses in the United States. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/))

Activities include purchase and regulated retail sale of electricity and natural gas, and transmission/distribution of electricity and distribution of natural gas to retail customers. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/))
current_context: Reported full-year 2025 adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings of $2.77 per share (GAAP net income $2.73 per share). ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))

Announced a $41.3 billion four-year capital plan and 7.9% rate base growth; expects annualized earnings growth near the top end of 5% to 7% through 2029. ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))

Outlined customer affordability initiatives including $60 million provided in direct assistance through the Customer Relief Fund. ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth is set to a low-to-mid single-digit trajectory consistent with Exelon’s utility/regulatory earnings profile and recent guidance. ([exeloncorp.com](https://www.exeloncorp.com/newsroom/exelon-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-and-initiates-2026-financial-outlook))

EBIT margin is modeled to gradually improve from the historical level toward ~20% as operating performance and regulatory recovery stabilize. ([investors.exeloncorp.com](https://investors.exeloncorp.com/financials-performance/income-statement/))

Reinvestment intensity is anchored to historical depreciation and capex rates; capex remains elevated in line with the stated multi-year capital plan. ([investors.exeloncorp.com](https://investors.exeloncorp.com/financials-performance/cash-flow/))

Working capital is structurally negative (current liabilities exceed current assets), providing incremental FCF support in the DCF framework. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/financials/balance-sheet/))
key_risks: Regulatory risk: adverse rate-case outcomes or timing shifts that reduce recoverable costs and compress margins versus base-case assumptions.
Cost/volume/weather and nuclear supply risks that can create quarter-to-quarter earnings volatility and lead to margin resets.
Liquidity/debt service risk given a high leverage profile for the sector; higher-for-longer rates could pressure WACC or realized financing costs.

Scenario design targets realistic sensitivity: revenue growth and EBIT margin move modestly (±1.0pp and ±0.5pp), while discount-rate and terminal growth shift slightly. ([stockanalysis.com](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/exc/statistics/))
